text_block_list.text:
Ah… e-excuse me! Sorry,
comin' through! Oof…
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text: Huh…? Teio, where'd you…? Ugh…
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey Nature.
Aren't you supposed to be on br—
text_block_list.name: Dorowa Committee Member

text_block_list.text: Sorry, but have you seen Teio anywhere?!
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text: Teio-san? Oh, I think I saw her…
text_block_list.name: Dorowa Committee Member

text_block_list.text: Teio! U-Um, I…
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text: …Wait, you changed already?
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
It's cause the collar of that suit was sooo
stuffy! It did make me look super cool,
though.
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
I showed off for the judges,
and I gave it my all out there!
Now I'm just waiting for the results.
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
…Oh. Ah, yeah,
of course!
Yeah… I suppose you wouldn't want to dance
anymore after that, huh.
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course. Good work! Seriously,
your dancing was so cool. Like,
I was watching from the gallery up above,
and…
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
You were so cool that I couldn't stand
watching you.
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text: Nature…?
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
Argh, no! Don't be weird, Nature! Aha, sorry,
Teio.
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
I think McQueen is the date you deserve.
She's your one and only rival,
the center of everyone's gaze.
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text: That's really, truly how I feel.
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text: …But, y'know!
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't have to be this year!
It doesn't even have to be next year!
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
Just, someday… will you dance with me,
too?
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
…Because I'm your rival and classmate,
too.
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text: Sounds good! Howzabout a dance right now?
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text: Yeah, I know, sorry. For now we can just— huh? R-Right now? Like, now?!
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text: Yup, right now!
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
B-But you're in your tracksuit and I'm in
my uniform!
We don't have any Dorowa dresses…
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
We can just go get changed again!
And you can just grab a rental dress for today!
C'mon, I'm sure they have one!
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
How are your legs feeling?
If you're hungry at all,
I can go grab us some snacks from the table
over there!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Chiyono O-san,
but I'm quite alright. …Oh, my.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: Alright, let's dance, Nature!
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
Oh… w-wait!
Just let me take one last deep breath real
quick!
I haven't practiced my steps at all!
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
C'mon,
I thought you made up your mind on this
already! Plus, this is just a hunch, but…
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
No matter what kinda dance we do,
I know you can keep up with me!
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
…Okay, then while we're dancing,
you have to look at me, too.
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
'Course I will! As your classmate and rival,
I'm gonna put your skills to the test,
'kay?
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text: So you took a step forward too, I see.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: …Ardan-san!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
No looking at other girls!
I'm your date for tonight.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Oh! 
…Yes, you're quite right.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: And so, our special night drew to a close.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Heya,
Chiyono O! You're real pumped up today.
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
Teio-san!
Congratulations on your win the other day.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
You deserved Best Date.
Seems like it was difficult to win against
you two after all,
what with our hasty preparation.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
You don't seem too down in the dumps to me,
though?
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
I got out all my anger and frustration that
night. 
Besides…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
This just means I have to think even harder
about how to win next time!
There's no time to waste being all
depressed!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You really do hate to lose too,
huh?
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san.
It seems Yaeno Muteki-san has joined us today.
Shall we begin with our partner running?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! I won't lose to either of you!
Not in race, nor in spirits!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
So, Teio-san,
did you relay to her that message Maruzen-san
gave you?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text: Ah! Ehehe, I totally forgot!
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
I'll go let her know she's better of telling
Chiyono O herself.
"I'm not gonna lose," that is!
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
